title: AIEAR autonomy gate evidence artifact
description: Per ADR-011 D3 (adaptation of ORIION ADR-037). Emitted by a local-only gate that GitHub CI cannot run: live-gold ru-STT/LLM (Yandex SpeechKit / GigaChat), RuStore Pay sandbox, on-device OEM survival (Firebase Test Lab / agent-device / physical OEM), or the adversarial audit. Committed to the PR branch under evidence/<gate>.json. The ci-evidence job asserts freshness (head_sha == PR head) + verdict == PASS for every gate the phase declares in evidence/manifest.json. Makes local gates un-fakeable at merge and doubles as the founder's post-hoc audit trail. Native-background phases MUST include a device-survival gate here (tripwire requires_device_evidence).

schema_version.description: Bump when the shape changes; verify_evidence.py pins this.

gate.description: Stable gate id, matches an entry in evidence/manifest.json required_gates. AIEAR gate ids: live_gold_stt, live_gold_llm, rustore_sandbox, device_survival, adversarial_audit, judge_panel_<fork>.

head_sha.description: Full 40-char SHA of the commit the gate actually ran against. MUST equal the PR head SHA at CI time, else the evidence is stale and the gate fails.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC when the gate completed.

verdict.description: PASS is the only value that lets ci-evidence go green for this gate.

cost_usd.description: LLM/FTL/infra spend to produce this evidence (funded live-gold, device-lab minutes). Feeds the per-run budget audit.

runner.description: Who produced it — agent role / script name (e.g. scripts/live_gold_stt.py, verifier, reviewer-security).

details.description: Free-form gate-specific payload: golden pass-rate + WER, RuStore sandbox tx ids, device matrix (OEM + screen-off minutes survived), reviewer verdicts + refute-by-default confirmation, etc.
